name: CardNest Season One Taxonomy

semantics.theme: Visual and world-building treatment. A theme is not a creature species, creature type, battle class, or literal identity.
semantics.creatureType: What the guardian actually is, such as celestial fledgling, forest cat, salamander, moth, or guardian.
semantics.battleClass: V3 gameplay role. This controls the class badge and future battle behavior.
semantics.nestAffinity: Prototype V3 elemental/gameplay affinity. It may share a name with a visual theme but remains a separate gameplay field.

Scout.role: speed, initiative, evasion, information and positioning

Support.role: healing, buffs, energy and team utility

publicCopyRules: Use '<Theme> Theme' in user-facing metadata labels.
Do not describe a guardian as being 'from the <Theme> clan'.
Do not use a theme name as the creature species or creature type.
Do not use a battle-class icon that belongs to a different battle class.
Theme icon and battle-class icon are independent fields and must never be inferred from one another.
